description: The ledger of the months case with the clock in the past, at 2023-07-15: a budget's months still run through the ledger's last transaction and its own last directive, and a budget defined after the clock's date has its months.

requests.bql: SELECT name, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last, count(*) AS months FROM #budgets GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, date FROM #budgets WHERE date = yearmonth(today())
